where.if: AND (tc.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR tc.module LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR tc.steps LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.module, tc.title, tc.precondition, tc.steps, tc.expected, tc.priority, tc.status, tc.creator_id, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at, u.login AS creator_login, u.name AS creator_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) AS run_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'PASS') AS pass_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'FAIL') AS fail_count, (SELECT r.result FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_result, (SELECT r.executed_at FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_run_at

SELECT
FROM test_cases tc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = tc.creator_id WHERE tc.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM test_cases tc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = tc.creator_id
ORDER BY tc.id

SELECT tc.module, tc.title, r.result, r.note, u.login AS executor_login, u.name AS executor_name, r.executed_at FROM test_runs r JOIN test_cases tc ON tc.id = r.case_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.executor_id ORDER BY r.id

SELECT tc.module, tc.priority, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM test_cases tc LEFT JOIN test_runs r ON r.case_id = tc.id
GROUP BY tc.module, tc.priority ORDER BY tc.module, tc.priority

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'PASS') AS pass_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'FAIL') AS fail_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'BLOCKED') AS blocked_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'SKIPPED') AS skipped_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) AS total_count, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'PASS') * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) ELSE 0 END AS pass_rate FROM test_cases tc
GROUP BY tc.id ORDER BY tc.id

SELECT DATE(r.executed_at) AS exec_date, COUNT(*) AS exec_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r2 WHERE r2.case_id = tc.id AND DATE(r2.executed_at) = exec_date AND r2.result = 'PASS') AS pass_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r2 WHERE r2.case_id = tc.id AND DATE(r2.executed_at) = exec_date AND r2.result = 'FAIL') AS fail_count FROM test_cases tc JOIN test_runs r ON r.case_id = tc.id
GROUP BY DATE(r.executed_at) ORDER BY exec_date

SELECT tc.module, COUNT(*) AS fail_count FROM test_cases tc JOIN test_runs r ON r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'FAIL'
GROUP BY tc.module ORDER BY fail_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT tc.id, tc.module, tc.title, tc.priority, tc.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'PASS') AS pass_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result != 'PASS' AND r.result != '' AND r.result IS NOT NULL) AS fail_count, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id AND r.result = 'PASS') * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id) ELSE 0 END AS pass_rate, (SELECT r.executed_at FROM test_runs r WHERE r.case_id = tc.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_run_at FROM test_cases tc
ORDER BY tc.id
